messages.author: 65e6f2ba12e155eb
messages.subject: shinyapps 403 Error when deploying app
parts:
Hi,

I get 403 error when deploying a shiny app to my.shinyapps.io. The following message and error are displayed in the R-console when shinyapps::deployApp() is run.

> deployApp()
Preparing to deploy application...
Error: /v1/applications/?filter=account_id:xxxxx&count=100&offset=0 403 - Forbidden


Any ideas?

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shinyapps 403 Error when deploying app
parts:
Hi,

Can you verify that your account token and secret are correct by going to:

https://my.shinyapps.io/user/tokens

and then using running:

shinyapps::setAccountInfo(name="<YOUR ACCOUNT NAME>", token="<YOUR TOKEN>", secret="<YOUR SECRET>")

Or using the copy button.

Thanks

-Andy

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] shinyapps 403 Error when deploying app
parts:
The issue is resolved. 
There was an extra "\n" character before the token and the secret strings even though I copied and pasted the keys.

Thanks for the help!
